# The load-level menu (F3 on the title) driven by the mouse (851-3178, 851-3245), with twelve levels in levels/:
# two pages. `!draft.lvl` is skipped (oLoadLevel drops names starting with "!"), `notes.txt` doesn't match
# `levels\*.lvl`, `Zed.LVL` matches ignoring case, and `ab` lists before `a_b` (NTFS's upper-cased order, which
# the oracle gets from patch 0011). Clicks the third row (232: oMenuSel's left release picks `a_b`), the page-down
# button (252: page 2, which activates page-up and deactivates page-down), a row past page 2's two levels with a
# click inside one frame (286: nothing), the page-up button (302, held 3 frames: back to page 1), and turns the
# wheel (315-317, no handler here; both ways in 317). Clicks the second row (325: `alpha`). Then presses the Load
# button (342: its sprite goes pressed), drags off it (344: its mouse leave resets the sprite) and releases (346),
# presses it again (352) and releases on it (354): `scrLoadLevel` loads levels/alpha.lvl and the level starts.
# Walks right (370-400). The window is 3x (screenScale 3), so a room pixel is three window pixels.
# story: room=rLoadLevel@200 customLevelName=ALPHA@354 nextCustomLevel=beta@354
